questions.question: Following a deployment in the Middle East lasting nearly seven months, which American aircraft carrier arrived back at its home port in San Diego?
questions.explanation: After completing its mission in the Middle East spanning nearly seven months, the USS Abraham Lincoln docked at North Island Naval Air Station in California.
questions.context: Middle Eastern crisis > 2026 Iran war > 2026 United States military buildup in the Middle East: The USS Abraham Lincoln returns to San Diego, California, U.S., at the North Island Naval Air Station following its nearly seven-month deployment in the Middle East.

questions.question: Which Canadian poet was honoured with the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature?
questions.explanation: The Swedish Academy awarded the prestigious literary prize to Anne Carson, praising her inventive work and engaging dialogue with classical tradition.
questions.context: 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature: Canadian poet Anne Carson is awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature for "her bold and inventive oeuvre that, in playful dialogue with the classical tradition, has created new forms for contemporary literature".

questions.question: According to Taiwan's finance ministry, surging international demand for which type of technology propelled the island's exports to a record high in September?
questions.explanation: Taiwanese export figures hit unprecedented levels in September, driven primarily by heavy worldwide demand for equipment linked to artificial intelligence.
questions.context: AI boom, Semiconductor industry in Taiwan: Taiwan's finance ministry reports that exports reached a record US$87.2 billion in September, while imports rose to a record $63.6 billion and the trade surplus reached a record $23.6 billion, citing demand for artificial intelligence-related hardware.

questions.question: Brian Kemp declared a state of emergency for which US state due to the approach of Hurricane Isaias?
questions.explanation: Anticipating the impact of Hurricane Isaias, Governor Brian Kemp enacted emergency measures across the state of Georgia.
questions.context: 2026 Atlantic hurricane season > Hurricane Isaias: In the United States, Georgia governor Brian Kemp declares a state of emergency ahead of Hurricane Isaias.

questions.question: Why did South Korea recall its diplomatic ambassador from Ukraine in October 2026?
options: Ukraine cancelled an agreed bilateral weapons shipment
Ukraine revealed the transfer of captured North Korean soldiers
Ukraine expelled South Korean defence attachés
Ukraine imposed sudden tariffs on South Korean electronics
questions.explanation: Seoul summoned its envoy home after alleging that Ukrainian authorities breached confidentiality by revealing that two detained North Korean troops had been sent to South Korea.
questions.context: South Korea–Ukraine relations, North Korean involvement in the Russo-Ukrainian war: South Korea recalls its ambassador to Ukraine after accusing Ukraine of breaching a non-disclosure agreement by disclosing the transfer of two captured North Korean soldiers to South Korea.
